name: @chethandvg/sonification-core
description: Turns measured rhythms into sound that keeps their ratios: a mapping grammar, audification and sonification manifests, in Rust, Python and WebAssembly.
author: Chethan Dandebala Venkatarama

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sonification_core_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sonification_core_wasm.wasm
